title: Coin Change
summary: Find the fewest coins that add up to an amount, or -1 when the amount can't be made.

tests.explain: 3 + 3. Taking the largest coin first gives 4 + 1 + 1, which needs three coins.
Coins of 2 only make even totals, so 3 can't be made.
An amount of 0 needs no coins at all.

hints: Greedy (largest coin first) fails: with coins 1, 3 and 4, it makes 6 as 4 + 1 + 1 instead of 3 + 3.
Let fewest[a] be the fewest coins that make the amount a. If the last coin you add is c, the rest is the amount a - c.
fewest[a] = 1 + min over coins c of fewest[a - c]. Start with fewest[0] = 0 and every other cell at Infinity, fill a from 1 up, and return -1 if fewest[amount] is still Infinity.

complexity.time: O(amount × number of coins): each amount tries every coin
